content:
You can choose to apply and unassign policies from groups to take effect across all
applications, or in the context of a specific application ( integration ). The information
you provide in the JSON file will differ depending on your goal.
If you are applying or unassigning a group policy you intend to be effective for those
group members for any application, then you will specify an array of groups
( apply_user_group_list ) to which to apply policy. For example:
Key
Value
apply_to_user_groups
An array of unique group identifiers. See the response
to Retrieve Groups to find group_id  values.
If you are assigning a group policy you intend to be effective for those group members
and targeted applications, then you will need to specify both an
app_integration_key  and an array of groups ( group_id_list ) when applying
policy to groups. For example:
Key
Value
app_integration_key
The unique identifier for the application (same value as
integration_key ). See the response to Retrieve
Integrations.
group_id_list
An array of unique group identifiers. See the response
to Retrieve Groups to find group_id  values.
